camel_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost SetPolicyAssetScope --region cn-hangzhou --ScopeType All --HostGroups.1.AccountNames.1 root --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --Databases.1.DatabaseId 3 --Hosts.1.HostAccountIds.1 96 --Hosts.1.HostId 1 --Databases.1.AccountScopeType AccountId --Databases.1.DatabaseAccountIds.1 3 --HostGroups.1.AccountScopeType All --Hosts.1.AccountScopeType All --HostGroups.1.HostGroupId 86 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PolicyId 7 --method POST --force
description_en: Specifies the assets to which a control policy applies
description_zh: 设置指定控制策略的资产生效范围
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost set-policy-asset-scope --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 7 --scope-type All --hosts '[{"AccountScopeType":"All","HostId":"1","HostAccountIds":["96"]}]' --databases '[{"AccountScopeType":"AccountId","DatabaseId":"3","DatabaseAccountIds":["3"]}]' --host-groups '[{"AccountScopeType":"All","HostGroupId":"86","AccountNames":["root"]}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetPolicyAssetScope

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the control policy that you want to modify.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html operation to query the control policy ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的控制策略的ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The scope of assets to which the control policy applies. Valid values:

- **All**: The control policy applies to all assets.

- **Host**: The control policy applies to specified hosts.

- **Database**: The control policy applies to specified databases.

- **HostGroup**: The control policy applies to specified asset groups
parameters.help_zh:
控制策略生效的资产范围。取值：
- **All**：针对所有资产生效
- **Host**：针对已选择的主机生效
- **Database**：针对已选择的数据库生效
- **HostGroup**：针对已选择的资产组生效
parameters.name: scope_type

element_fields.help_en:
The scope of host accounts to which the control policy applies. Valid values:

- **All**: The control policy applies to all accounts of the host.

- **AccountId**: The control policy applies specified accounts of the host
element_fields.help_zh:
控制策略生效的主机账户范围。取值：

- **All**：针对主机中的所有账户生效
- **AccountId**：针对主机中指定的账户生效
element_fields.name: account_scope_type

element_fields.help_en:
The host accounts to which the control policy applies.

> This parameter is required if AccountScopeType is set to AccountId
element_fields.help_zh:
控制策略生效的主机账户范围。

> 当AccountScopeType为 AccountId 时必填
element_fields.name: host_account_ids

parameters.help_en:
The hosts to which the control policy applies.

> This parameter is required if ScopeType is set to Host. You can specify up to 500 hosts
parameters.help_zh:
控制策略生效的主机范围。

> 当ScopeType为 Host 时必填。最多500 个
parameters.name: hosts

element_fields.help_en:
The scope of database accounts to which the control policy applies. Valid values:

- **All**: The control policy applies to all database accounts of the database.

- **AccountId**: The control policy applies to specified database accounts of the database
element_fields.help_zh:
控制策略生效的数据库账户范围。取值：

- **All**：针对数据库中的所有账户生效
- **AccountId**：针对数据库中指定的账户生效
element_fields.name: account_scope_type

element_fields.help_en:
The database accounts to which the control policy applies.

> This parameter is required if AccountScopeType is set to AccountId
element_fields.help_zh:
控制策略生效的数据库账户范围。

> 当AccountScopeType为 AccountId 时必填
element_fields.name: database_account_ids

parameters.help_en:
The databases to which the control policy applies.

> This parameter is required if ScopeType is set to Database. You can specify up to 500 databases
parameters.help_zh:
控制策略生效的数据库资产范围。

> 当ScopeType为  Database 时必填。最多500 个
parameters.name: databases

element_fields.help_en:
The scope of asset accounts to which the control policy applies. Valid values:

- **All**: The control policy applies to all accounts in the asset group.

- **AccountName**: The control policy applies to specified accounts in the asset group
element_fields.help_zh:
控制策略生效的资产账户范围。取值：

- **All**：针对资产组中的所有账户生效
- **AccountName**：针对资产组中指定的账户生效
element_fields.name: account_scope_type

element_fields.help_en:
The asset accounts to which the control policy applies.

> This parameter is required if AccountScopeType is set to AccountName
element_fields.help_zh:
控制策略生效的资产账户范围。

> 当AccountScopeType为 AccountNames 时必填
element_fields.name: account_names

parameters.help_en:
The asset groups to which the control policy applies.

> This parameter is required if ScopeType is set to HostGroup. You can specify up to 100 asset groups
parameters.help_zh:
控制策略生效的资产组范围。

> 当ScopeType为  HostGroup 时必填。最多100 个
